verdict.rationale: FutureHouse's own Literature agent can run deep literature reviews that synthesize evidence across hundreds of papers, drawing on 175M+ papers with traceable citations. The client API also lets users submit and batch many literature tasks programmatically. However, nothing documents a systematic screening workflow (inclusion/exclusion criteria) or structured per-paper data extraction applied consistently across a paper set; the output described is a synthesized report. Missing for 10: documented screening against defined criteria, structured per-paper extraction outputs (e.g., tables or fields), mechanisms ensuring consistent criteria across papers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
